name: Into the Time Vortex
oracle_text:
Cascade (When you cast this spell, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card that costs less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost. Put the exiled cards on the bottom in a random order.)
Rebound (If you cast this spell from your hand, exile it as it resolves. At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.)
blocked_sentences: Rebound (If you cast this spell from your hand, exile it as it resolves. At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.)

needs.what: the residual gate (verify._covered) claiming a printed "Rebound (...)" line when the card declares the card-level `rebound: true` rider, so an instant or sorcery whose only text is keyword lines (cascade + rebound, no spell_effects) can be authored
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The engine and loader already support `rebound: true` (Fantastic Elasticity ships with it), and cascade is the `cascade` op on a stack spell_cast trigger. But Fantastic Elasticity's Rebound line is only claimed because a sorcery with any spell_effects has all its lines consumed; with no spell_effects, `_covered` has claimants for kicker, uncounterable, evoke etc. but none for rebound, so verify fails at residual with 'printed text not represented: Rebound'. Padding spell_effects with a `noop` would pass only by gaming the gate, so it was not done. Once the claimant exists the answer is: rebound: true, a triggered ability {active_zones: [stack], trigger: {event: spell_cast, source: self, controller: you}, effects: [{op: cascade}]} carrying the Cascade line, expectation {zone: exile}.
